methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Regression analyses were first applied to the electricity use in the company, and it was found that the most prominent variables affecting electricity use were the cooling degree days and the Penicillin plant production; these variables can predict electricity consumption by 69.7%.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A prominent pharmaceutical industrial company in Jordan was taken as a case study to illustrate the application of the LSS_EnMS in a real case utilizing real energy data.

level_3b.evidence_quote: A prominent pharmaceutical industrial company in Jordan

stage1.notes: Primarily a proposed EnMS framework (LSS_EnMS) integrating Lean Six Sigma DMAIC with ISO 50001, demonstrated on one pharmaceutical company in Jordan with real energy data; single-applied-case vs methodological/theoretical is borderline. Embedded EnB: multiple regression of electricity use on cooling degree days + Penicillin plant production (69.7%). Pharmaceutical (batch) is not a closed-list continuous-process sector, so level_3b=false.
